cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Everything Has Two Prices
cards.instruction: Price every offer twice: once in practical terms and again through an emotional cost that grows when the offer returns.

mechanism: Copy a shop tag's strike-through without knowing it marks damaged stock, then price a dress loan in cash and escalating acknowledgment of earlier mockery.
confusable: Not just forcing an apology: the practical price must remain explicit while B's renewed offer increases the emotional terms, using the corrected copied tag.
comparison: Dress loan and judgment acknowledgment rather than delayed contact in a car.
seedUse: Retains ten-pound dress loan/mocked taste and higher payment; adds mistaken discount tag copied from damaged stock.
